faq.question: What is Dayjoy?
faq.answer: Dayjoy Marketing Private Limited is a wellness and direct selling company founded in 2018, based in Kota, Rajasthan, India. It offers health, beauty, personal care, food, home care, and agricultural products through a direct selling model.

faq.question: Who founded Dayjoy?
faq.answer: Dayjoy is part of the Adila Group, which was founded by Shambhu Kumar Agarwal in 2009. Dayjoy Marketing Private Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is led by directors Anmol Agarwal and Divyansh Agarwal.

faq.question: Where is Dayjoy headquartered?
faq.answer: Dayjoy's registered office is at A-780, Indra Vihar, Kota, Rajasthan - 324005, India.

faq.question: What products does Dayjoy sell?
faq.answer: Dayjoy sells 150+ products across categories: Health Care (Asthprash, juices, tablets, teas), Personal Care (Wild Muse brand - face wash, shampoo, creams), Food Products (spices, oils), Home Care (cleaning products), Textiles, and Agriculture (Happy Grow).

faq.question: What is the Dayjoy business plan?
faq.answer: Dayjoy uses a Hybrid Compensation Plan combining Binary Income (10%), Generation Income, Mentorship Bonus, Performance Incentive (5-21%), and multiple rank-based bonuses including Gold Director, Platinum Director, Emerald VP, Sapphire VP, and Diamond President bonuses.

faq.question: How do I join Dayjoy?
faq.answer: Registration is free. After registration, purchase products worth Rs 2,500-3,000 (1000 BV) to activate your account. Joining packages are Rs 7,600 or Rs 7,700 (5000 PV). Visit dayjoy.in to register.

faq.question: What is the minimum purchase to start earning?
faq.answer: You need to shop for Rs 2,500-3,000 worth of products to earn 1000 BV points and start earning from the compensation plan.

faq.question: What is BV in Dayjoy?
faq.answer: BV stands for Business Volume. It is the point value assigned to products. 1 BV = Rs 2 (max). BV is used to calculate all income and bonuses in the compensation plan.

faq.question: How does the Binary Income work?
faq.answer: Binary Income is 10% matching. You need 2 direct referrals (1 left, 1 right). Per pair earns Rs 500. Daily capping is Rs 2,500 and monthly capping is Rs 75,000.

faq.question: What are the ranks in Dayjoy?
faq.answer: Ranks from lowest to highest: Distributor, Gold Director (1,60,000+ BV), Platinum Director (7,50,000 BV), Emerald VP (30 Lakh BV), Sapphire VP (1 Crore BV), Diamond President (2.25 Crore BV).

faq.question: What is Asthprash?
faq.answer: Asthprash is Dayjoy's flagship health product - a herbal formulation (300g, Rs 2,999) that protects lungs from pollution and promotes respiratory health.

faq.question: Is Dayjoy a legitimate company?
faq.answer: Yes, Dayjoy Marketing Private Limited is registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (CIN: U52600RJ2018PTC062258), incorporated under the Companies Act 2013. It is an Active private limited company registered with ROC Jaipur.

faq.question: How many states does Dayjoy operate in?
faq.answer: Dayjoy has a presence in 24 states across India with over 1,000 franchise outlets and 4 regional offices in Jharkhand, Odisha, Delhi, and Hyderabad.

faq.question: What is the loyalty program?
faq.answer: If you purchase minimum Rs 3,000 worth of products every month for 5 consecutive months, you get free products worth your 5-month average in the 6th month. Amounts scale from Rs 3,000 to Rs 6,000 per month.

faq.question: What is the parent company of Dayjoy?
faq.answer: Dayjoy operates under the Adila Group, founded by Shambhu Kumar Agarwal in August 2009. Adila Group is dedicated to creating world-class products.

faq.question: What payment methods does Dayjoy accept?
faq.answer: NEFT, IMPS, Cheque, Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, Net Banking, and PayTM.

faq.question: How can I contact Dayjoy?
faq.answer: Email: support@dayjoy.in, Phone: +91 74120 34387, Website: dayjoy.in, Address: A-780, Indra Vihar, Kota, Rajasthan - 324005.

faq.question: What is the Mentorship Bonus?
faq.answer: Mentorship Bonus is 100% of the Business Matching Incentive earned by your directly sponsored distributors. You must have personally referred 2 teams to qualify.
